items.title: Johnny Varro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: And I was there for about eight months playing intermission with Buzzy Drootin and the band consisted of ... Walter Page ... And then that whole band went to England ... and that’s when we had Walter Page on bass.

ctx.x: Oh my. Well see 19 — you said this is the early 50s? © Fillius Jazz Archive -7-

Well I’m kind of jumping around a lot. I don’t mean to. But the love romance was around 1950. And then working at Nick’s was ’54, ’55, ’56. And then Condon’s was ’57. And I was there for about eight months playing intermission with Buzzy Drootin and the band consisted of Wild Bill, Peanuts, Cutty Cutshall, George Wettling, Gene Schroeder and Arvell Shaw maybe or Walter Page, one of the two.
